headline_decisions.decision: Rebind pod MCP from 0.0.0.0 to 172.17.0.1 (option A) then add a bearer token (option B); the code default is already 127.0.0.1 and the HTTP server has no auth.

From this workstation, 8765 and 8091 are NOT reachable off-host (TCP timeout); 22 is open. Internet exposure is currently closed from this vantage, but internal and docker-network reachability is unchanged.
Remove SupplementaryGroups=docker from pod-mcp (POD_USE_DOCKER=0) and add systemd confinement; docker-group membership is host-root-equivalent.
Validate the DeepSeek key only with GET /user/balance and GET /models (200 valid, 401 invalid, 402 no balance); never with a chat completion.
evidence: [V] api-docs.deepseek.com (first call, list-models, balance, error codes)

headline_decisions.decision: Rotate with an 8-step spend-free runbook: create B, root-only store, restart gateway only, validate B, revoke A, confirm A=401, record fingerprint, re-run preflight.
Pin DeerFlow by tuple: commit SHA 58fc5bd + image digests + uv.lock + compose/config/extensions hashes; reject main (2.3.0-dev) and floating tags.
All adopted donor mechanisms are MIT/Apache-2.0; the AGPL, CC BY-NC-SA, proprietary and unlicensed candidates stay excluded.
The repo has no LICENSE/NOTICE and the vendor Craft binaries have no checksums; ship NOTICE + SBOM and record vendor version/hash/EULA.
Resolve redis:7-alpine resolved version/licence at pin time (>=7.4 RSALv2/SSPL reported) and postgres:16 (PostgreSQL Licence); prefer digest pin or Valkey if policy forbids.
No per-key DeepSeek spend limit is documented; enforce budgets client-side (episode token/wall/cost caps, user_id attribution, balance monitor, fail-closed on 402).

blast_radius.statement: pod is in the docker group => code execution as pod is host-root-equivalent (host FS mount, read every container env incl. DEEPSEEK_API_KEY). MCP is unauthenticated; only boundary is ufw source ranges.

threat_model.principle: Fail closed, least privilege, verify without spend; every control has an independent observable (TCP result, HTTP status, hash, id, licence scan, balance check).

validation.verdict: Validate with metadata endpoints only; never with a chat completion.
validation.model_note: deepseek-flash is served by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017; legacy deepseek-v4-flash names retired
procedure: Presence only: docker exec deer-flow-gateway sh -lc 'test -n "$DEEPSEEK_API_KEY" && echo present || echo MISSING'
Balance: printf 'header = "Authorization: Bearer %s"\n' "$DEEPSEEK_API_KEY" | curl -K - -sS -o /dev/null -w 'balance_http=%{http_code}\n' https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance (inside the container)
Models: same curl -K - pattern against https://api.deepseek.com/models
validation.why_curl_K: Keeps the secret out of ps/argv; the header is written to curl's config on stdin (printf is a shell builtin).

result_matrix.200/200: key valid, egress works, balance readable -> proceed
result_matrix.401: invalid/revoked/wrong environment -> rotate; never retry with a value found on disk
result_matrix.402: auth succeeded but balance insufficient -> top up or reduce budget; key valid
result_matrix.429: rate/concurrency -> back off; not a validity signal
result_matrix.5xx/timeout/DNS: provider or network, not the key -> retest later; check egress

validation.forbidden: POST /chat/completions as a key test (spends quota, creates a billable event, proves nothing extra).
validation.billing_caveat: [I] Metadata endpoints generate no tokens and docs price chat tokens; treating them as zero-spend is an inference from endpoint semantics, not an explicit billing statement.

steps.action: Record current key fingerprint without printing value
Create key B in platform.deepseek.com/api_keys (linked by official error-codes page)
Point gateway at B (env_file/drop-in); restart only gateway container
Confirm A returns 401 (if value retained securely)
Schedule next rotation (90 days or on incident)

rotation.rollback: Revoke B and re-enable A in the platform; restart container onto previous env file; never leave two active keys indefinitely.

spend_controls: Episode budgets: max_tokens, max_wall_s, max_attempts, per-episode cost cap; fail-closed refusal when absent/exceeded
user_id parameter per episode for attribution/isolation (documented)
Concurrency cap 1-2 on the 2 vCPU host regardless of the 2500 account allowance
Scheduled zero-spend GET /user/balance; alert on is_available=false; 402 terminates the run
Cost ledger reconciled with balance delta; missing usage -> UNVERIFIED, never estimated silently
No autonomous top-up/account/model changes without an approval token
